Users report being unable to log in when typing their email address in lowercase or mixed case if they registered with capital letters (e.g. 'Alice.Smith@Example.COM').
In `get_user_by_email`, lookups currently fail because dictionary keys are matched with exact case.
Email lookups and registration must be case-insensitive, normalizing emails to lowercase so that `get_user_by_email('alice.smith@example.com')` correctly returns the user registered as 'Alice.Smith@Example.COM'.
Inviolable constraints:
- Must preserve return type dict | None
- Do not modify existing method signatures
Acceptance oracle: `test_case_insensitive_email_lookup` must pass.
